items.x: Attorney general says site impersonated a Sarasota County resident.

items.t: Rays pitching coach Kyle Snyder guided by Sarasota roots to World Series
items.x: Tampa Bay Rays pitching coach Kyle Snyder has reached the World Series, but his love of baseball started when he was a child in Sarasota.

items.t: Daily Dose: New heart guidelines for women, a next-gen weight loss drug beats Ozempic and what new data reveals about profound autism
items.x: Four medical groups unveiled a lifelong heart health roadmap for women, from first period through menopause, built around key hormonal changes.

items.t: Brooke Hogan blasts ‘fake, greedy people’ after Hulk’s Florida home sale: ‘Enjoy your dirty money’
items.x: Brooke Hogan is lashing out at the "fake, greedy people" she claims profited from her late father Hulk Hogan as she mourns the sale of the wrestling legend's Florida home.

items.t: Rays stun Brewers with 2-run rally in 12th inning and force World Series Game 5 with 4-3 win
items.x: The Tampa Bay Rays staved off elimination from the World Series with a 4-3 win over the Milwaukee Brewers, forcing Game 5.

items.t: Judge overseeing Maduro trial dies
items.x: Alvin Hellerstein, a longtime federal judge who was set to oversee the criminal trial of deposed Venezuelan leader Nicolás Maduro, has passed away, according to a court official. He was 92.

items.t: ‘She was screaming for her life’: Terrifying attempted kidnapping caught on video
items.x: A terrifying kidnapping attempt in the middle of the afternoon in Honolulu was caught on video.

items.t: Self-checkout may be faster for shoppers, but it comes at a cost for stores
items.x: Do you tend to use self-checkout when you're at a store? New research has found that, when available, more than half of transactions go through self-checkout.

items.t: Black women on the ballot in the midterms could make history across the country
items.x: A record 72 Black women are on the midterm ballot — for the Senate, House, governorships and statewide offices. Researchers say they're challenging assumptions about electability. What's your view?

items.t: WATCH: Florida homeowner holds armed car burglar at gunpoint, deputies say
items.x: A Florida homeowner held an armed man at gunpoint after finding him rummaging through vehicles, according to the Walton County Sheriff's Office.

items.t: US cruise ship suspends three-year world voyage over fuel costs, leaving passengers in Cambodia
items.x: A U.S. cruise ship on an around-the-world voyage that touted its cabins as floating homes suspended its three-year voyage in Cambodia due to fuel costs, forcing hundreds of passengers to disembark.

items.t: Junior Caminero injures foot during Rays' rally but says he'll play in World Series Game 5
items.x: All-Star slugger Junior Caminero injured his left foot during the Tampa Bay Rays' late rally in Game 4 of the World Series on Tuesday night but said he'll play Wednesday in Game 5.

items.t: Road rage incident ends in gunfire, 1 man arrested in Florida
items.x: A road rage incident in southwest Florida ended with gunfire.

items.t: Florida man hit by truck during roadside haircut stunt for TikTok, 3 arrested

items.t: Americans want less processed foods, but price is getting in the way
items.x: A recent survey has found that more than 50% of grocery shoppers in the U.S. have bought more of certain foods in the past year because they seemed less processed, had fewer additives or contained ingredients they preferred.

items.t: Epileptic woman dies after going to ChatGPT for medical advice; family files lawsuit against OpenAI
items.x: The family of a Seattle woman who died of a seizure after tapering off her medication is suing OpenAI, claiming ChatGPT gave her faulty medical advice.

items.t: Man accused of threatening girl with a gun to get in his car later determined to have .292 BAC, deputies say
items.x: The sister of a man accused of threatening a girl with a gun to get in his car said that the whole thing was a “huge misunderstanding.”

items.t: Tampa woman rams patrol car trying to flee deputies: HCSO
items.x: A Tampa woman was arrested on Wednesday after ramming a Hillsborough deputy’s patrol car while trying to flee, officials said.
